method: For each of the two faithful order-1920 local large-K2,2 markings in the complete coset-action census through degree 12, freeze the exact marked multiplication table, adjoin the F=S3xS3 and collision-J=S4 seam relations, and enumerate every subgroup of index at most 12 in the resulting finitely presented colimit.
conclusion: No transitive permutation action of either exact colimit through degree 12 preserves all three required vertex orders Q=1920, F=36, J=24. The degree-10 action preserving J=24 collapses Q to 60 and F to 12; every degree-12 action preserving Q=1920 collapses F and J to order 6.
scope: This is an exact exhaustive bound for transitive actions of degree at most 12, not a universal colimit computation and not a proof that no faithful finite completion exists.
